turns.question: What was the total ad spend on days when the email campaign had no booked lead, from 17 August to 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: Ad spend (EUR) on email-channel campaigns was 430.00 EUR across the 43 days from 17 August to 2 October 2026 that had no booking; I excluded the 4 days with a booking (21 August, 2 September, 14 September and 26 September).
